title: Leave margins for site notifications
goal: Use margin to adjust spacing outside elements and center narrower blocks horizontally.
summary: The school bus temporarily changed its stop. Move the site notification to the middle of the card and leave space between the description and notification.
tasks: Centers the notification block horizontally, retaining the existing width and padding.

example.note: correspond to the top, left, and bottom in sequence. When the block is narrower than the container, the left and right autos will divide the remaining space equally.

hint: padding increases the space within the border. To distance the notification box from the description above, use margin-top or margin.
